newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-AMERICAN LASSITER TO PLAY FOR ITALY'S GENOA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AMERICAN LASSITER TO PLAY FOR ITALY'S GENOA.

text.p: U.S. international striker Roy Lassiter, top scorer in Major League Soccer's first season with 34 goals for the Tampa Bay Mutiny, has joined Italian second division side Genoa on loan until next spring.
Tuttosport daily said on Friday Lassiter, 27, had begun training with Genoa and would remain until March 30 when the serie B club would decide whether to sign him.
Lassiter will be the second American to play in Italy after defender Alexi Lalas spent two seasons with Padova in serie A until leaving to join the fledgling MLS last year.
